changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS spare_part_reorder_request ( reorder_id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, stock_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES spare_part_site_stock(stock_id), spare_part_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES spare_part_master(spare_part_id), site_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES site_master(site_id), vendor_id BIGINT REFERENCES vendor_master(id), requested_quantity NUMERIC(14,3) NOT NULL, estimated_unit_cost NUMERIC(12,2) DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, estimated_total_cost NUMERIC(14,2) DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(30) DEFAULT 'REQUESTED' NOT NULL, expected_date DATE, remarks VARCHAR(1000), requested_by BIGINT REFERENCES users(id), requested_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP );
